description.value: Neverland Tea Salon is a whimsical high tea destination founded in 2013 in Kitsilano's West Broadway, co-created by Oscar-nominated screenwriter Terri Tatchell and theatre producer Renee Iaci. The intimate space serves seasonal afternoon teas seven days a week and is a popular venue for private celebrations accommodating up to 40 guests. Cyclists planning a deliberate stop will find a distinctive, locally-owned experience with dietary-inclusive menus in the heart of one of Vancouver's most bikeable neighbourhoods.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms OSM contact details (address, phone, website all match). The site is clearly active with 2026 seasonal menu references (Cherry Blossom through May 31, Summer High Tea from June 1). The FAQ explicitly states vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and dairy-free options are offered. No mention anywhere on the site of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or device charging, so those remain null per evidence rules.
concerns: High tea is reservation-required and seating is time-limited (1.5 hours); spontaneous drop-in cyclists may not be accommodated, especially on weekends and holidays.
No bike parking or cyclist-specific amenities confirmed from website; these are unknown and may warrant a direct inquiry before listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, locally-owned food and drink establishment on a major Vancouver cycling corridor with confirmed contact details and dietary-inclusive menu; a worthwhile planned stop for touring cyclists, though advance reservations are strongly recommended.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ states: 'We offer gluten/dairy omitted, vegetarian and vegan. Please indicate in your reservation notes whether anyone in your party will be ordering our Gluten & Dairy Free or Vegan & Gluten Free options.'
